description.value: A multi-location Irish pub chain in Vancouver, the Denman Street location sits in the West End neighbourhood a short ride from the Stanley Park seawall cycling routes. The pub offers live music, food, and cold beer in a 'home away from home' atmosphere with both indoor and outdoor seating. A loyalty rewards program and Uber Eats delivery are available.
